answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the karst is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the cedar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the quill of the next round. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
